title: Friday
bodyText:
WELCOME TO FRIDAY

Your AI assistant that gets things done

Friday helps you achieve complex goals with simple clicks. Here's how it works:

Tell Friday your goal

Pick what you want to achieve. No technical knowledge needed.

Friday investigates

You click to decide
